priority.body: Fastest, cheapest, best value or most comfortable. Results re-rank instantly.

best.body: Every step timed, total cost, the weather and exactly when to leave home.

book.body: Book every bookable leg in one payment, keep all tickets in the app and get refunded automatically if a service is cancelled.

operator.body: Passengers pay upfront into escrow. Scan the ticket at boarding and the fare goes straight to you. Cancel a service and every passenger is refunded automatically.
